title: FiberCore event envelope (as published by the outbox relay)
description: The envelope the relay publishes today. It is NOT the events.v2.2 schema (docs/addenda/v2.2/contracts/events.v2.2.schema.json): that one requires event_id, subject_id and ingested_at and forbids extra fields, so an external consumer that validates against v2.2 must not be pointed at this stream. `source` and `quality` carry the v2.2 meaning (quality enum) additively. Moving to the v2.2 shape is a coordinated change with the consumers, not done here.
